shortDescription: Create, terminate, start or stop a service in ECS

options.name: access_key
options.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID) or C(AWS_ACCESS_KEY) environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The I(aws_access_key) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive. The I(aws_access_key_id) alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

options.name: aws_ca_bundle
options.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The C(AWS_CA_BUNDLE) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: aws_config
options.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation U(https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config).

options.name: capacity_provider_strategy
options.description: The capacity provider strategy to use with your service. You can specify a maximum of 6 providers per strategy.

options.name: client_token
options.description: Unique, case-sensitive identifier you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request. Up to 32 ASCII characters are allowed.

options.name: cluster
options.description: The name of the cluster in which the service exists. If not specified, the cluster name will be C(default).

options.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
options.description: Use a C(botocore.endpoint) logger to parse the unique (rather than total) C("resource:action") API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the C(aws_resource_action) callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The C(ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: delay
options.description: The time to wait before checking that the service is available.

options.name: deployment_configuration
options.description: Optional parameters that control the deployment_configuration. Format is '{"maximum_percent":<integer>, "minimum_healthy_percent":<integer>}

options.name: deployment_controller
options.description: The deployment controller to use for the service. If no deploymenet controller is specified, the ECS controller is used.

options.name: desired_count
options.description: The count of how many instances of the service. This parameter is required when I(state=present).

options.name: enable_execute_command
options.description: Whether or not to enable the execute command functionality for the containers in the ECS task. If I(enable_execute_command=true) execute command functionality is enabled on all containers in the ECS task.

options.name: endpoint_url
options.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints.  While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The  C(AWS_URL) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: force_deletion
options.description: Forcibly delete the service. Required when deleting a service with >0 scale, or no target group.

options.name: force_new_deployment
options.description: Force deployment of service even if there are no changes.

options.name: health_check_grace_period_seconds
options.description: Seconds to wait before health checking the freshly added/updated services.

options.name: launch_type
options.description: The launch type on which to run your service.

options.name: load_balancers
options.description: The list of ELBs defined for this service. Load balancers for an existing service cannot be updated, and it is an error to do so. When the deployment controller is CODE_DEPLOY changes to this value are simply ignored, and do not cause an error.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the service.

options.name: network_configuration
options.description: Network configuration of the service. Only applicable for task definitions created with I(network_mode=awsvpc).

options.name: placement_constraints
options.description: The placement constraints for the tasks in the service. See U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/APIReference/API_PlacementConstraint.html) for more details.

options.name: placement_strategy
options.description: The placement strategy objects to use for tasks in your service. You can specify a maximum of 5 strategy rules per service.

options.name: platform_version
options.description: Numeric part of platform version or LATEST See U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/platform_versions.html) for more details.

options.name: profile
options.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html). The C(AWS_PROFILE) environment variable may also be used. The I(profile) option is mutually exclusive with the I(aws_access_key), I(aws_secret_key) and I(session_token) options.

options.name: propagate_tags
options.description: Propagate tags from ECS task defintition or ECS service to ECS task.

options.name: purge_placement_constraints
options.description: Toggle overwriting of existing placement constraints. This is needed for backwards compatibility. By default I(purge_placement_constraints=false). In release 9.0.0 this will be changed to I(purge_placement_constraints=true).

options.name: purge_placement_strategy
options.description: Toggle overwriting of existing placement strategy. This is needed for backwards compatibility. By default I(purge_placement_strategy=false). In release 9.0.0 this will be changed to I(purge_placement_strategy=true).

options.name: region
options.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, I(region) is ignored. The C(AWS_REGION) environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information U(http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region).

options.name: repeat
options.description: The number of times to check that the service is available.

options.name: role
options.description: The name or full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that allows your Amazon ECS container agent to make calls to your load balancer on your behalf. This parameter is only required if you are using a load balancer with your service in a network mode other than C(awsvpc).

options.name: scheduling_strategy
options.description: The scheduling strategy. Defaults to C(REPLICA) if not given to preserve previous behavior.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) or C(AWS_SECRET_KEY) environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The I(secret_key) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive. The I(aws_secret_access_key) alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

options.name: service_registries
options.description: Describes service discovery registries this service will register with.

options.name: session_token
options.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) environment variable may also be used. The I(session_token) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the service.

options.name: tags
options.description: A dictionary of tags to add or remove from the resource.

options.name: task_definition
options.description: The task definition the service will run. This parameter is required when I(state=present) unless I(force_new_deployment=True). This parameter is ignored when updating a service with a C(CODE_DEPLOY) deployment controller in which case the task definition is managed by Code Pipeline and cannot be updated.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: When set to C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting I(validate_certs=false) is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting I(aws_ca_bundle) instead.

options.name: wait
options.description: Whether or not to wait for the service to be inactive. Waits only when I(state) is C(absent).
